definitions.explanation: A flexible container made of paper, plastic, or cloth used for carrying or storing things.

examples.japanese: レジ{袋|ぶくろ}をください。
examples.english: Please give me a plastic bag.

examples.japanese: {買|か}った{物|もの}を{袋|ふくろ}に{入|い}れてください。
examples.english: Please put the things I bought in a bag.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{買|か}い{物|もの}の{時|とき}、{袋|ふくろ}を{持|も}ってくる{人|ひと}が{多|おお}いです。お{金|かね}がかかるからです。
examples.english: In Japan, many people bring their own bags when shopping because bags cost money.

notes:
{袋|ふくろ} means bag or sack - a flexible container for carrying or storing things.

COMMON TYPES:
- レジ{袋|ぶくろ}: shopping bag (at register)
- {紙|かみ}{袋|ぶくろ}: paper bag
- ビニール{袋|ぶくろ}: plastic bag
- エコバッグ/{買|か}い{物|もの}{袋|ぶくろ}: reusable shopping bag
- {手提|てさ}げ{袋|ぶくろ}: tote bag with handles
- {寝袋|ねぶくろ}: sleeping bag
- {給料|きゅうりょう}{袋|ぶくろ}: pay envelope

COUNTER:
{枚|まい} for flat bags, {個|こ} for filled bags

SHOPPING IN JAPAN:
Since 2020, plastic bags cost money at most stores. Staff often ask:
- {袋|ふくろ}はいりますか？: Do you need a bag?
- {袋|ふくろ}は{有料|ゆうりょう}です: Bags cost extra

Many people bring their own エコバッグ (eco-bag/reusable bag).
